intro.zh: 从地表温度空间模拟、不同地类精度验证，到卫星观测与在轨成像论证，展示 STREAM 在遥感数字孪生研究中的应用。
intro.en: Explore STREAM applications in remote sensing digital twins, from spatial simulation of land surface temperature and evaluation across land cover types to satellite observation and imaging assessment.

tag.zh: 地表过程 · 空间分布

summary.zh: 以组分温度连接辐射传输与能量平衡过程，模拟复杂地表的温度空间分布，并与 Landsat 地表温度进行对比。
summary.en: Component temperatures link radiative transfer and energy balance processes to simulate spatial temperature patterns over complex surfaces, with Landsat land surface temperature used for comparison.

text.zh: 如何在复杂地表场景中表征地表温度的空间差异？
text.en: How can spatial temperature differences be represented over complex land surfaces?

text.zh: 耦合辐射传输与能量平衡过程，开展地表温度空间模拟。
text.en: Couple radiative transfer and energy balance processes to simulate spatial patterns in land surface temperature.

text.zh: 并列展示 Landsat 与 STREAM 的地表温度分布，比较空间格局与局地变化。
text.en: Compare Landsat and STREAM temperature maps side by side to examine spatial patterns and local variations.

caption.zh: Landsat 与 STREAM 地表温度空间对比
caption.en: Spatial comparison of Landsat and STREAM land surface temperatures

summary.zh: 面向乔木林、灌丛、草地、耕地与裸地，比较 STREAM、ERA5 和 GLDAS 的温度偏差与均方根误差。
summary.en: Compare temperature bias and root mean square error for STREAM, ERA5 and GLDAS over forest, shrubland, grassland, arable land and bare land.

text.zh: 不同地表类型下，温度模拟的偏差和误差有何差异？
text.en: How do temperature simulation bias and error vary across land cover types?

text.zh: 按地类分别统计 Bias 和 RMSE，并与 ERA5、GLDAS 进行对比。
text.en: Evaluate Bias and RMSE separately for each land cover type and compare STREAM with ERA5 and GLDAS.

text.zh: 图示五类地表中，STREAM 的 RMSE 均低于 ERA5 和 GLDAS；各类地表的差异可在原图中查看。
text.en: In the five land cover types shown, STREAM has lower RMSE than ERA5 and GLDAS. The original figure provides the results for each type.

caption.zh: 五类地表下 STREAM、ERA5 与 GLDAS 的 Bias 和 RMSE 对比
caption.en: Bias and RMSE for STREAM, ERA5 and GLDAS across five land cover types

tag.zh: 观测几何 · 在轨成像

summary.zh: 耦合地表、大气、轨道与传感器要素，模拟卫星观测与成像过程，为热红外传感器波段和角度优选提供支持。
summary.en: Couple surface, atmosphere, orbit and sensor elements to simulate satellite observations and imaging, supporting the assessment of thermal infrared spectral bands and viewing angles.

text.zh: 面向真实地表状况和典型应用，开展传感器指标优化仿真论证。
text.en: Assess sensor specifications through simulation under real surface conditions and representative applications.

text.zh: 结合卫星轨道与观测几何、地表热辐射和大气辐射传输，模拟大气顶亮温。
text.en: Combine satellite orbit and observation geometry, surface thermal radiation and atmospheric radiative transfer to simulate top-of-atmosphere brightness temperature.

text.zh: 展示卫星配置、时空范围设置及观测覆盖模拟界面。
text.en: Explore the interface for satellite configuration, spatial and temporal settings, and simulated observation coverage.

caption.zh: StreamSensor 卫星配置与观测覆盖模拟界面
caption.en: StreamSensor satellite configuration and observation coverage simulation interface

secondary_caption.zh: 地表—大气—轨道—传感器耦合流程示意
secondary_caption.en: Coupled surface, atmosphere, orbit and sensor processes
